audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart reads "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet chart both read Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri. The page renders two different answers to who wins each level.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range with a slow and her Mantra is off cooldown from level 1 (40/38/36/34s, shortened further by her passive whenever she damages you), so she prices you out of levels 1-3. Ahri has no gap-closer until Spirit Rush at 6, after which the lane flips.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Karma, phases[3].side = Skill, phases[4..6].side = Ahri, matching win[0..6] already on disk.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Karma peaks in the level 3-5 Mantra-Q poke window; Ahri spikes at 6 with Spirit Rush (140/120/100s), again on first item, and scales into flank picks. Karma has no burst item path and plateaus.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if the link survives, and Ahri is one of the few mids who can guarantee breaking it. Text also calls Karma "he"/"his" throughout and uses the invented label "Focused Resolve (Tether)".
audit.why: Riot's own text: "Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy... If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted." W range is 675 and its cooldown is a flat 12s at every rank. Spirit Rush (three dashes) or simply walking past 675 range ends it before the root lands. Mantra-W also heals Karma, so extended chip trades want Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Name it Focused Resolve (W), 12s flat, 675 range; break the tether by leaving range; anti-heal before committing to long trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s flat and Ahri's Charm is 12s flat — they trade one-for-one, so the sequencing rule is simply who spends first.
audit.corrected: Added concrete 12s-vs-12s sequencing to cooldowns, winCon, tradeBad and the loading tips.

audit.why: Riot text: "Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration."
audit.corrected: Added to dontsFull[2].d as a Grievous Wounds cue.
